home.whoami: My name is Vera Olegovna Pertsukova. I am an artist, teacher, illustrator, 3d designer and just a good person. I am glad to see you on my website. Here you can get acquainted with my creativity, works, achievements, as well as learn about the news from my professional life.
home.buy: I will be glad if you like any of my works, and even more so if you decide to buy it or order a painting. I hope you will enjoy spending time here and want to visit my site again and again. Stay tuned.
home.world: The world is an amazing place, and it takes my breath away just thinking how much more there is to learn and do.
home.convinced: I am convinced that a person should not bury his talents, but multiply them. Therefore, I try to constantly develop myself and pass on the accumulated knowledge to my children and students.
home.development_text: I constantly develop in various artistic techniques and directions, exploring new materials and formats.
home.inspiration_text: I draw inspiration from the surrounding world, nature, emotions, and cultural heritage.
home.philosophy_description: Each work is not just an image, but a story, an emotion, a piece of soul. I strive to create art that resonates with people on a deep level.
home.expression_text: Conveying emotions through color and form
home.harmony_text: Balance of composition and color solutions
home.growth_text: Constant search for new techniques and ideas
home.sharing_text: Sharing knowledge, inspiration, and beauty is what gives meaning to the creative journey.
home.cta_text: Ready to dive into the world of art? Explore my works, learn about news, or get in touch for collaboration.

services.p_one: As an artist and teacher, I provide painting services in various ways materials and on any surfaces, as well as teaching children fine arts at home and in the classroom.
services.p_two: I approach painting and teaching with great responsibility, everyone once achieving an excellent result. There was not a single case when my client I would be dissatisfied.
services.p_three: As materials when painting paintings, materials such as watercolor, oil, charcoal, pencil, pastel, gouache, and as a basis - canvas, canvas on cardboard, cardboard, paper.
services.collaborate_text: Whether you need a custom painting, illustration, or art lessons, I'm here to help bring your vision to life.

payment.p_one: At the moment, my store operates according to a simplified scheme.
payment.p_two: You contact me in any way convenient for you, we agree on the picture and the price, and after the preliminary full payment of the picture and shipment, I send you the picture.
payment.contact_text: Reach out via email, social media, or phone. We'll discuss your desired artwork, size, style, and timeline.
payment.agree_text: Once we agree on details, you make a full prepayment securely. I'll provide an invoice and confirmation.
payment.creation_text: I create your artwork with care, then ship it via reliable courier. You'll receive tracking updates.
payment.custom_text: For custom paintings, a 50% deposit is required before starting, with the remainder due upon completion.
payment.production_text: Typical production time is 2‑4 weeks for original works, plus shipping time. Digital illustrations take 1‑2 weeks.
payment.ready_text: Have questions or want to discuss a specific artwork? Feel free to reach out—I'm happy to help!
